summary: Phase 2: Implement source adapters and deterministic golden-case comparator

delivery.outcome: Implement read-only GitHub and Markdown source adapters, explicit golden-case metric mapping, and deterministic comparator for work-summary vs GitHub.
nonGoals: Modify external repositories directly in this checkout.
Implement an LLM reasoning engine or mutating runtime.

architecture.decision: Implement deterministic source adapters and comparator in src/data2dsl_adapters.py and src/data2dsl_comparator.py producing autogrammar.data2dsl comparison bundles.
architecture.rollback: Remove src/data2dsl_adapters.py, src/data2dsl_comparator.py and tests/test_golden_case_e2e.py; return Phase 2 to planning.

validation.evidence: All unit and E2E tests pass with MATCH, CONFLICT, MISSING, and UNEVALUABLE outcomes validated against contract schema.
